metadata.title: 3 Ingredient Nutella Fudge Cake | One Pot Chef
metadata.description:
My 3 Ingredient Nutella Fudge Cake is a decadent and over-the-top dessert, perfect for sharing with friends. Nutella is combined with eggs and flour, then baked. Once cool, the cake is topped with a generous slathering of even more Nutella. This is not for the faint of heart. If you love Nutella, you’ll love this cake -  give it a go!

ONE POT CHEF COOKBOOKS - PAPERBACKS AND EBOOKS:
http://www.lulu.com/spotlight/onepotchef

ONE POT CHEF COOKBOOKS ON iTUNES BOOKSTORE:
http://itunes.apple.com/au/artist/david-chilcott/id478668534?mt=11

===============
INGREDIENT LIST:
===============

1 1/2 Cups of Nutella (plus extra for frosting, optional)
4 Eggs
1/2 Cup of Plain All-Purpose Flour

Preparation Time: About 5 minutes
Cooking Time: About 35-40 minutes

SERVES  6 - 8

All measurements and temperatures are in Australian Metric.

nodes.plm_caption: The video shows someone making a chocolate cake. The man wears a red shirt and a white apron. He holds up a white plate with a chocolate cake, then a pile of meatballs. Then there is a blue bowl containing 6 eggs and a jar of Nutella. He pours the Nutella into the egg mix and whips it up in a hand-held mixer. He then adds flour to the mix. A bundle of parchment paper is shown, and then the Nutella mix is poured into a tin and baked.  The baked cake is shown on a plate next to a full jar of Nutella. Then the person takes a large bite out of the cake. Then he takes a picture of the cake with a spoon. He laughs in the last scene, and we see his Instagram handle @onepotchef.

summary.brief: The chef mixes Nutella, eggs, and flour, bakes a dense cake, tops it with extra Nutella, and enjoys a slice.
summary.detailed: The presenter, a man wearing a red shirt and a white apron, begins by cracking four eggs into a blue mixing bowl, adds one and a half cups of Nutella, and beats the mixture with a hand‑held electric mixer until it becomes light and increases in volume. He then folds in half a cup of plain all‑purpose flour. After greasing and lining a 20 cm (8‑inch) cake tin with parchment paper, he pours the thick batter into the tin and places it in a pre‑heated oven set to 180 °C (350 °F) for about 35–40 minutes. Once baked, the cake cools in the tin for ten minutes, then is turned onto a wire rack to cool completely. When fully cooled, he spreads a generous layer of additional Nutella over the top, slices a piece, places the slice on a white plate beside a full jar of Nutella, lifts a fork (or spoon), takes a large bite, and smiles. He briefly photographs the cake with a spoon, laughs, and the video ends with on‑screen graphics displaying his Instagram handle @onepotchef and other social‑media links.

action.detailed: Mix the eggs and Nutella, fold in the flour, pour the batter into a parchment‑lined tin, bake, cool, spread Nutella on the top, slice, and take a bite.
action.actor: The One Pot Chef, a man in a red shirt and white apron

nodes.plm_caption: A guy is standing by a counter wearing a apron. He holds up a cake before the segment cuts. Then he shows and whips together the ingredients for a chocolate cake. And the video ends with the cake with chocolate frosting, with a glass of milk on the side. There are titles and logos for twitter, facebook, and youtube.

summary.brief: A chef mixes eggs, Nutella and flour, bakes the batter, and spreads Nutella over the cooled cake.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a man in a red T‑shirt and a white apron standing at a kitchen counter. He cracks four eggs into a bowl, adds one and a half cups of Nutella and beats the mixture with an electric hand‑mixer until it becomes light and increases in volume. He folds in half a cup of plain all‑purpose flour, then greases a 20 cm (8‑inch) cake tin and lines the base with non‑stick baking paper. He pours the batter into the prepared tin and places it in a pre‑heated oven set to 180 °C (350 °F) for about 35–40 minutes. After baking, the cake cools in the tin for roughly ten minutes, is turned onto a wire rack to cool completely, and can be dusted with a little icing sugar if desired. Finally, the chef spreads a thick layer of Nutella over the top of the cooled cake and presents the dark, dense, moist cake on a white plate.

action.detailed: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add Nutella and beat until fluffy, fold in flour, pour the batter into a greased and lined tin, bake, cool, then spread a generous layer of Nutella over the cooled cake.
action.actor: The chef, a man wearing a red T‑shirt and a white apron

summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The presenter, a man wearing a red shirt and a white apron, begins by cracking four eggs into a blue mixing bowl, adds one and a half cups of Nutella, and beats the mixture with a hand‑held electric mixer until it becomes light and increases in volume. He then folds in half a cup of plain all‑purpose flour. After greasing and lining a 20 cm (8‑inch) cake tin with parchment paper, he pours the thick batter into the tin and places it in a pre‑heated oven set to 180 °C (350 °F) for about 35–40 minutes. Once baked, the cake cools in the tin for ten minutes, then is turned onto a wire rack to cool completely. When fully cooled, he spreads a generous layer of additional Nutella over the top, slices a piece, places the slice on a white plate beside a full jar of Nutella, lifts a fork (or spoon), takes a large bite, and smiles. He briefly photographs the cake with a spoon, laughs, and the video ends with on‑screen graphics displaying his Instagram handle @onepotchef and other social‑media links.
